title: 2012 Economic Census for Business Activity: results overview, construction and service industries
publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan / Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry
methodology: National Economic Census, establishment tabulation; Table I-1 reports establishment count, workers and sales by detailed industry. Necessary-item respondents only; management/support establishments excluded from this establishment tabulation.
assessment: Primary public source. Exact national 3914 game-software-industry worker count recovered: 9,452. Strongest dated observation in this pass.
access_status: Primary researcher downloaded official PDF and visually checked Table I-1; archived economic-census-2012-services.pdf.
next_step: Recover equivalent2016 and2021 rows with matching coverage.

title: 2016 Economic Census for Business Activity, Service Industries B, detailed industry table 1-1

assessment: Primary and directly relevant; catalogue confirms 3914 and workers. Exact national row was not recovered from the interactive surface in this bounded pass.
access_status: public interactive database; API requires application ID and direct HTML request timed out.
next_step: Use browser/table download to obtain CSV/XLSX, then visually verify 3914 row and survey date.

title: Japan Standard Industrial Classification 3914: Game software industry
methodology: Official industry-classification definition.
assessment: Primary scope authority: game-software creation and related research/analysis/advice for console, portable and PC systems; disc/cartridge manufacturing excluded.

title: 2021 Information and Communications Industry Basic Survey (FY2020 results) news release
publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry and Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
methodology: Annual Information and Communications Industry Basic Survey; information-service companies are classified by largest-sales business activity (main-industry basis).

next_step: Collect common worker-status table from each annual release and verify survey universe/method breaks before constructing a separate annual series.

title: Information and Communications Industry Basic Survey: FY2010 results, Chapter 5 information services
publisher: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry
methodology: Annual survey table reports company count, regular workers, worker status and dispatched workers by information-service company category.
assessment: Primary source demonstrating annual employment fields and game-software-company category. It reports a 20.8% rise in game-software companies' average regular workforce, but the absolute game category total was not extracted in this pass.
access_status: public PDF indexed by METI; direct command-line download returned 403.
next_step: Retrieve through a normal public browser and transcribe the game-software-company row with all column headings.

title: CESA Game Industry Report 2025 release
years: published 2025-12-15; employment observation year not stated
methodology: Public summary of paid 462-page industry report; detailed employment estimation method not in release.

access_status: public PDF; existing project raw copy inspected
next_step: Do not buy or infer timing unless the full report is explicitly authorised; retain existing contextual treatment.

title: CESA Game Industry Report 2024 release
years: published 2024-12-20; employment observation year not stated

assessment: Public release calls game-related total industrial population around 200,000 but gives no dated stock, scope diagram or public method. Not evidence of 2024 employment.
next_step: Keep as corroborating origin of CESA context estimate only.

title: Survey report on analysis and spillover effects of the game software industry
publisher: CESA; research commissioned to Japan Research Institute
years: published 2008-11; economic model uses 2007 calendar-year domestic market
methodology: Input-output analysis of direct and peripheral demand. Employment-inducement count uses the employment table accompanying the input-output table; includes employees, paid officers, proprietors and family workers.
assessment: Primary public report but not workforce stock. It calculates 63,863 induced workers from about JPY1tn economic effect and explicitly warns the effect need not create additional jobs.
next_step: Use only if analysing economic multiplier methodology; exclude from employment trend.
